subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dropped**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**dropped**'.
 
• It is so because a peasant had accidentally let the heavy sack fall on the chicken. (ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि एक किसान ने गलती से भारी बोरी को मुर्गे के ऊपर गिरा दिया था)
 
• It means **'to let something fall'.** (गिराना, गिरने देना)
 
 
• *Example: That vase was very expensive. Whatever you do, don’t **drop** it!*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *"a peasant had accidentally **dropped** a heavy sack..."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **picked**: to choose somebody/something from a group of people or things. ((व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं के समूह में से) चुनना, चयन करना, छाँटना)
 
• **filled**: to make something full or to become full. (किसी में कुछ पूरी तरह से भरना या किसी वस्‍तु का पूरा भर जाना)
 
• **selected**: to choose somebody/something from a number of similar things. (एक जैसे व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं में से एक को चुनना; चयन करना)
